scope_note: Governance/ecosystem token of Manta Network, not a stablecoin, wrapped, staked, RWA or leveraged token. Listed on Binance since TGE on 2024-01-18 (more than 90 days ago). Treated as an ERC-20 (F1-F9), not a native coin (N1-N3): MANTA exists as an ERC-20 contract on Manta Pacific (0x95Ce...44E5), bridged to Ethereum via the OP-stack L2StandardBridge (0x4200...0010 holds 211.35M). Its supply is set by the contract and a mint Safe (0xbeCA...bBCf received 40.4M of mints beyond the 1B CoinGecko max), not by protocol consensus emission. So the native-coin replacement doesn't fit and contract tests apply. The bridge escrow on Pacific is ~20.3% of 1,040.4M on-chain supply, so the Ethereum L1 deployment would also need F and D checks; not done (stopped at E1).
